items.title: Avakian George — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Bill Gottlieb is the only other person I know who met him and talked to him.

ctx.x: There’s no recording of it, and I can’t remember what he said, except it was depressing. Isn’t that sad.
Bill Gottlieb is the only other person I know who met him and talked to him.
Yeah. Nesuhi Ertegun met him in Washington and recorded him, actually.
